steps.message:
The issue is an infinite loop in `rich.text.Text.append` when a `Text` instance with a style is appended to itself.

In `Text.append`, when `text` is a `Text` instance, the code iterates over `text._spans` to extend `self._spans`. If `self` and `text` are the same object, adding a span to `self._spans` immediately increases the number of spans in `text._spans`, which the generator expression (or `extend` call) continues to iterate over, leading to an infinite loop.

FILES: rich/text.py:987-1003 (Text.append)
CAUSE: Appending a `Text` instance to itself when it has spans causes the `extend` loop to iterate over the spans being added.
FIX: Create a static list of spans from `text._spans` before extending `self._spans` to avoid iterating over the growing list.
REPRO: `t = Text("a", style="bold"); t.append(t)` hangs.
TESTS: tests/test_text.py
